think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and valid range from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it has sentinel numeric values (e.g., -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (disable/auto/special behavior) rather than just scaling the same effect. 3) For any candidate sentinel, verify it is documented as changing semantics (not merely being an extreme point on the same continuum). 4) Classify as a special knob only if such sentinel values exist; otherwise treat it as a regular numeric knob.
